subject.title: Feishu: replied/quoted message mentions show as raw @_user_N placeholders

question: Should maintainers adopt or narrow the existing fork candidate for this Feishu quoted-mention bug, or discard it and queue a fresh narrow repair?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible, but the direct OpenClaw PR is closed unmerged and the remaining fork PR is open but conflicting, so automation should not create another duplicate fix path without maintainer direction.

options.title: Adopt a narrow repair
options.body: Review the fork/same-head work for useful authorship, then land only the small `send.ts` parser/test fix needed for fetched mention metadata.

options.title: Queue a fresh repair
options.body: Close or ignore the conflicting candidate and let ClawSweeper create a new focused repair PR against current main.

options.title: Keep waiting on the fork
options.body: Ask the fork author to rebase and provide real Feishu proof before OpenClaw does any replacement work.

recommendation.title: Adopt a narrow repair
recommendation.body: Review the fork/same-head work for useful authorship, then land only the small `send.ts` parser/test fix needed for fetched mention metadata.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Feishu mention-rendering work and tests make this the strongest available routing signal for the maintainer choice.
